We recommend the Pricing & Billing Master Data team load the escalated price and prepare a supplementary invoice for approval.", "rebill_note_subject": "F-008 | Polaris Mesh Labs Inc | C-2029 | Potential underbilling review - HTC-2005", "rebill_note_body": "INTERNAL - for review and approval; not for customer distribution.

Finding F-008: Potential underbilling on contract C-2029, SKU HTC-2005 (Sensor module), customer Polaris Mesh Labs Inc.

Root cause: MISSED_ESCALATION - the contractual annual price escalation was never applied in billing.

Contract basis: Clause A.2 (page 3) sets the price at USD 36.00 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides a 4.5% annual increase effective each January 1, commencing January 1, 2025.

Calculation: USD 36.00 (base price) x (1 + 4.5%) [2025-01-01] = USD 37.62. Latest billed price: USD 36.00.

Impact: 12 invoice lines, 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-20. Potential underbilling USD 27,368.28; estimated recoverable USD 27,368.28.

Proposed action (owner: Pricing & Billing Master Data): load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2025-01-20, and prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for approval.

Approval required before any rebilling."}
